description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the ProductReviewDao interface in a Spring-based e-commerce application. It provides methods to retrieve product reviews based on customer and product criteria, involving complex JPQL queries with multiple joins, and to fetch reviews by ID or with language-specific filters.

classes.name: ProductReviewDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ProductReviewDao interface, utilizing Querydsl for complex JPQL queries to retrieve product reviews based on various criteria.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews associated with a specific customer, joining related entities for comprehensive review data.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews for a specific product, including customer and language details, joining multiple related entities.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Fetches a single product review identified by both product ID and customer ID, with related entity fetch joins.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves product reviews for a given product with a specific language context, supporting localized review data.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a product review by its unique ID, including related customer and product details.
